cells.gaps: No source found shows an AI system in service in a second government body, or rules or a register for the government's own use of AI. The labour portal's AI is a virtual assistant in the same body; the elections commission said in 2024 that it uses AI for civic education and content, naming no system.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-25: the elections commission said in October 2024 that it uses AI for civic education and content creation, but named no AI system in service, so it is not a second body and the cell stays at 3.
